P9 (17.101) accepted risk, narrowed by P10 (17.103): a matching content hash still does not prove the tool wrote the file, but the reconciliation path now records such a file as Ownership=AdoptedExisting (shown as "adopted existing file"), which rollback does not delete, overwrite or re-ACL; only legacy records without the key and normal writes backed by journal or intent evidence are treated as tool-owned.
